lead: Novo Nordisk / NOVO-B.CO — Ozempic pulls up a chair at Thanksgiving
smaller: Amazon / AMZN — Black Friday's crowd shops where it invests
Alibaba / BABA — Jack Ma blinks, bargain hunters circle
Cameco / CCJ — A fund's uranium jackpot advertises the trade
why_lead: With US markets shut for Thanksgiving and crypto flat (BTC -0.38%), the freshest crowd story is weight loss at the holiday table: newly published Novo capacity news (n1762, n0745, n1763, n1745) and Morgan Stanley's food-stock risk list (n0845), with Novo +1.01% to 709.30 DKK and +4.55% over five sessions. Real retail-attention evidence (n0337 retail investors crowd into Lilly) plus mainstream spillover (n0426, n0731, n1678, n1706). Analog is the second-order-trade mechanism (n0633 med-tech rebound) with McDonald's/PepsiCo card context; smart-money split between science/capacity bulls (n1663, n1652) and cost/tolerability caution (n0373, n1636); breaks on capacity-driven competition, safety (n1688), payers and the 676.50 DKK 20-session reference.
why_smaller: Amazon: Black Friday itself, with the crowd shopping where it invests (+20.86% over 20 sessions to 146.71 USD; n0811, n1729, n0089); a different angle from the 2023-11-22 off-price item, with cost-of-living and Walmart-grocery competition (n0091, n0790) as the break.
Alibaba: newly published founder reversal (Jack Ma halts share sales, n0230, n0826) after the 2023-11-17 cloud-spin-off item; value hunters versus target cuts (n0444) and competition (n0245).
Cameco: a fund's uranium jackpot headline (n1761) and a +14.65% 20-session run (URA +8.92%); NuScale lawsuit and a revoked small-reactor contract (n0762, n0407) supply the sentiment break.
